test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What amount of ‘Seed Capital’ is provided as support to a Self-Help Group under the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹40,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) **scheme offers a grant of **Rs 40,000 **per member of a **Self-Help Group (SHG) **for working **capital and small tool purchases.**
 
• Each SHG can receive a total seed capital of Rs 40,000 per member, with a maximum cap of Rs 400,000 per SHG.
 
• This **seed capital** is provided as a grant to the SHG Federation by SRLM/SULM, which subsequently lends it to individual SHG members.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The PMFME scheme, launched by the **Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)** in collaboration with State and Union governments, operates as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
 
• Its primary objective is **to offer financial, technical, and business support** to enhance existing micro-food processing enterprises.
 
• The scheme provides credit-linked subsidies of up to Rs 10 lakh to facilitate the establishment or modernization of new micro food processing units.
 
• The PMFME scheme boasts a total outlay of Rs 10,000 crore spanning five years, from 2020-21 to 2024-25, with the aim of supporting 200,000 micro food processing units.
